properties.description: Triggers when a container restart count increases in the application namespace.

allOf.query: [format('KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(5m) | where Namespace == "{0}" | summarize FirstRestartCount=min(ContainerRestartCount), LastRestartCount=max(ContainerRestartCount) by ContainerName | where LastRestartCount > FirstRestartCount', parameters('appNamespace'))]

properties.description: Triggers when a 5xx response appears in application container access logs.

allOf.query: [format('ContainerLogV2 | where TimeGenerated > ago(2m) | where PodNamespace == "{0}" | where LogMessage has "HTTP/" | extend StatusCode=toint(extract(" ([0-9]{{3}}) [0-9]+ ", 1, tostring(LogMessage))) | where StatusCode >= 500', parameters('appNamespace'))]

properties.displayName: Pet Store - Failed or pending pods
properties.description: Triggers quickly when failed or pending pods are detected in the application namespace.

allOf.query: [format('KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(2m) | where Namespace == "{0}" | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ContainerName | where PodStatus in ("Failed", "Pending") or ContainerStatus =~ "waiting"', parameters('appNamespace'))]

properties.description: Triggers when container inventory reports CrashLoopBackOff, OOM, image-pull, or startup errors.

allOf.query: [format('KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(2m) | where Namespace == "{0}" | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ContainerName | where ContainerStatusReason in~ ("CrashLoopBackOff", "OOMKilled", "Error", "ImagePullBackOff", "ErrImagePull")', parameters('appNamespace'))]
